nodes.label: Web Favicon (48x48)
nodes.description: 48x48 RGBA small web browser favicon. Light blue-white dominant color (~rgb(198,226,249)) with blue accents (~rgb(0,112,208)). Used as the browser tab icon when the app runs on web via Expo Web.

edges.note: Favicon (48x48) is the web browser tab version of the app icon; shares blue color palette
